tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalization", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 2)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    
    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water")
    sample_liquids = [protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}") for i in range(1,25)]
    
    # Hard-coded volumes from normalisation
    sample_volumes = [5.88, 4.17, 11.36, 7.46, 2.38, 5.26, 15.15, 3.33, 6.41, 8.33, 4.95, 9.09, 2.63, 6.94, 10.42, 3.85, 5.68, 20.0, 7.81, 4.55, 12.82, 2.86, 5.43, 8.62]
    diluent_volumes = [44.12, 45.83, 38.64, 42.54, 47.62, 44.74, 34.85, 46.67, 43.59, 41.67, 45.05, 40.91, 47.37, 43.06, 39.58, 46.15, 44.32, 30.0, 42.19, 45.45, 37.18, 47.14, 44.57, 41.38]
    
    # Load liquids into source plate (samples)
    for i in range(24):
        well_name = chr(ord('A') + i // 12) + str(i % 12 + 1)
        source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquids[i], volume=sample_volumes[i])
    
    # Load water into destination plate wells
    for i in range(24):
        well_name = chr(ord('A') + i // 12) + str(i % 12 + 1)
        dest_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=diluent_volumes[i])
    
    # Load pipette
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    
    # Transfer samples
    for i in range(24):
        well_name = chr(ord('A') + i // 12) + str(i % 12 + 1)
        p20.aspirate(sample_volumes[i], source_plate[well_name])
        p20.dispense(sample_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_name])
    
    p20.drop_tip()"}

from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalization", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 2)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    
    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_liquids = [protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#FF0000") for i in range(1,25)]
    
    # Hard-coded volumes from normalisation
    sample_volumes = [5.88, 4.17, 11.36, 7.46, 2.38, 5.26, 15.15, 3.33, 6.41, 8.33, 4.95, 9.09, 2.63, 6.94, 10.42, 3.85, 5.68, 20.0, 7.81, 4.55, 12.82, 2.86, 5.43, 8.62]
    diluent_volumes = [44.12, 45.83, 38.64, 42.54, 47.62, 44.74, 34.85, 46.67, 43.59, 41.67, 45.05, 40.91, 47.37, 43.06, 39.58, 46.15, 44.32, 30.0, 42.19, 45.45, 37.18, 47.14, 44.57, 41.38]
    
    # Load liquids into source plate (samples)
    for i in range(24):
        well_name = chr(ord('A') + i // 12) + str(i % 12 + 1)
        source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquids[i], volume=sample_volumes[i])
    
    # Load water into destination plate wells
    for i in range(24):
        well_name = chr(ord('A') + i // 12) + str(i % 12 + 1)
        dest_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=diluent_volumes[i])
    
    # Load pipette
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    p20.pick_up_tip()
    
    # Transfer samples
    for i in range(24):
        well_name = chr(ord('A') + i // 12) + str(i % 12 + 1)
        p20.aspirate(sample_volumes[i], source_plate[well_name])
        p20.dispense(sample_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_name])
    
    p20.drop_tip()
```

metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalization", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalization", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack_20ul = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    tip_rack_300ul = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 5)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 2)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", 4)
    
    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_liquids = [protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#FF0000") for i in range(1,25)]
    
    # Hard-coded volumes from normalisation
    sample_volumes = [5.88, 4.17, 11.36, 7.46, 2.38, 5.26, 15.15, 3.33, 6.41, 8.33, 4.95, 9.09, 2.63, 6.94, 10.42, 3.85, 5.68, 20.0, 7.81, 4.55, 12.82, 2.86, 5.43, 8.62]
    diluent_volumes = [44.12, 45.83, 38.64, 42.54, 47.62, 44.74, 34.85, 46.67, 43.59, 41.67, 45.05, 40.91, 47.37, 43.06, 39.58, 46.15, 44.32, 30.0, 42.19, 45.45, 37.18, 47.14, 44.57, 41.38]
    
    # Load liquids into source plate (samples)
    for i in range(24):
        col = i // 12
        row = i % 12 + 1
        well_name = chr(ord('A') + col) + str(row)
        source_plate[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquids[i], volume=sample_volumes[i])
    
    # Load water into reservoir (sufficient volume for proper immersion)
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=3000)  # load enough for proper immersion
    
    # Load pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack_20ul])
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tip_rack_300ul])
    
    # Transfer water and samples with fresh tip each time and mix
    for i in range(24):
        col = i // 12
        row = i % 12 + 1
        well_name = chr(ord('A') + col) + str(row)
        
        # Transfer water using p300
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(diluent_volumes[i], reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(diluent_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_name])
        p300.drop_tip()
        
        # Transfer sample using p20
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(sample_volumes[i], source_plate[well_name])
        p20.dispense(sample_volumes[i], dest_plate[well_name])
        p20.mix(5, 10, dest_plate[well_name].bottom(0.5))  # mix from lower depth
        p20.drop_tip()"}
